slides.texte_overlay:
6 protector habits
every man should have

1. If a Friend Has Been Drinking...
Take His Keys:

No debate.
Call the cab.
He'll thank you tomorrow.

2. If Someone Looks Lost...
Ask If They Need Help:

One question.
Point the way.
Small help, big relief.

3. If Someone Is Being Mocked...
Change the Subject:

No speech.
Just end the joke.
The room follows.

4. If Your Mother Calls Late...
Pick Up:

Always.
It might be nothing.
It might be everything.

5. If You Have Five
Free Minutes... Learn
Something Useful:

First aid, a fact, a skill.
Knowledge protects too.
